summary: Allocation accounts in Business Central general journals: how to use Generate lines from allocation account to split an expense by the account definition and adjust the lines before posting. The demo uses an equal split across multiple G/L accounts.
overview: This short video (published 2024-12-12) shows how allocation accounts split an expense. Normally the split happens at posting, according to the allocation account definition. The video enters an expense in a general journal, then uses the Generate lines from allocation account function to split the line before posting.
key_points: With allocation accounts, the split normally happens when the expense is posted, according to the account definition.
In a general journal, choose Actions, Functions, Generate lines from allocation account line to split the amount into separate lines.
The demo uses an allocation account that splits an expense into equal shares across several G/L accounts.
Generating the lines first lets you intercept and adjust the split before posting.
Steps shown: create an expense in general journals, generate lines from the allocation account, then adjust the lines before posting.
